source.design: G3 · Tagesblatt (Paper page "Bausteine · G3"), on top of G2 · Gerät

rules: Only the alp token family is valid for OpenBand screens; its values are the G2 · Gerät language.

alp-page is the page, alp-canvas the raised panel (Gehäuse), alp-well the recess inside a panel, alp-inset a pressed-in surface on the page. Raised panels carry the key shadow; nothing else does. No gradients except the tab-bar-free bottom fade.
Values sit on scales (Messleisten) with labelled ends; the personal baseline is a grey band, today is a pointer.
Refused or missing values use alp-inset surfaces, alp-gap hollows and a stated reason; never a fabricated number.
Dark mode swaps every alp token for its alp-dark twin.
Small metric text uses the -text variant.
Type is Helvetica Neue on Apple (Bold, Medium, Regular), the same face as Paper. Inter / Inter Tight is the fallback on Android and in tests that have not loaded Helvetica.

G3: colour marks only values outside the personal normal range: better = green family (alp-better text, alp-better-mark marker, alp-better-tint chip), worse = amber family (alp-worse, alp-worse-mark, alp-worse-tint). Neutral inside the range and without a trusted baseline. alp-led stays the live-connection green. alp-recovery/alp-signal (orange) are G2 legacy and unused in G3.

G3 name mapping to Paper: Paper --color-alp-better/worse (marker) = code alp-better-mark/worse-mark; Paper --color-alp-better-text/worse-text = code alp-better/worse; Paper --color-alp-dark-better/worse (marker) = code alp-dark-better-mark/worse-mark. The Paper file's pre-G2 alp values (blue Alpin 3) are archive values; this file is the code source of truth for existing roles.

G3: one lead number per screen (text-alp-lead with leading-alp-lead and tracking-alp-lead; decimals may step down to 72). Second ink level alp-ink-2 for body and meta text. The Für-heute note (alp-note*) is the only filled block. Zones use the monochrome alp-zone-1..5 ramp and alp-zone-tint-1..5 chart bands.
